Individuals covered under group policies have had their claims rejected on technical grounds like slight delays in intimation of claims. IRDA has advised insurance companies that contractual conditions should not prevent them from considering genuine claims. This is especially if unavoidable circumstances prevented the consumer from following some of the policy conditions like time-frame for intimation.
